intro: Battleboar Flanks are hearty cuts of meat harvested from the vicious battleboars trained by Bristleback quilboar in Mulgore. Collected by young hunters around Camp Narache, they serve both as proof of culled threats and as nourishing sustenance for the tauren tribe.

p: The Bristleback quilboar lurking in Brambleblade Ravine have trained vicious battleboars to encroach on tauren hunting grounds. While these aggressive beasts pose a direct hazard to the young tauren coming of age at Camp Narache, nothing taken from nature is wasted. Grull Hawkwind directs novice hunters to harvest the flanks of these felled beasts alongside their snouts. The cuts of flank provide rich, sustaining meat that is cooked down into hearty stew for the tribe's youth, turning a quilboar weapon of war into vital tribal nourishment.
